additions.site_name: Texas Critical Data Centers (TCDC) campus, Ector County (Odessa)
additions.name: Texas Critical Data Centers (TCDC) Phase 1 — planned AI data-centre phase of about 200 MW (20-year Vistra PPA)

status.summary: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: NUAI) announced on 21 September 2026 that its subsidiary TCDC PowerCo LLC had signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Luminant ET Services Company LLC, a Vistra affiliate, for a minimum of 200 MW and up to 207 MW for Phase 1 of its Texas Critical Data Center (TCDC) project, supplied from Vistra's 1,180 MW gas-fired generating facility in Odessa, which the release says is immediately adjacent to the TCDC site; power is expected in Q3 2027 (a forecast). The release describes TCDC as a 493-acre Permian Basin site planned to scale to 1.4 GW and says the land is secured and construction permits are in hand. This records the named Phase 1 project as announced on 21 September 2026. The county permits are not identified by number, date or approved scope, so permitted status is not asserted; no site grading, building construction, tenant, completion or operation is established, and the PPA megawatts are contracted power supply, not IT load.
